The JSON fixture preserves an actual Codex Luna review captured through ALA on 2026-10-07. `revenue-review.md` is a deterministic Markdown conversion of that recorded content. The static chart and its CSV visualize the same two supplied source values (12 and 10 EUR million); they were authored locally for rendering/validation tests. These files do not run or simulate an AI agent and are never refreshed automatically.

Office and ZIP fixtures (`source-document.*`, `source-presentation.*`, `analysis-type.zip`) are small, hand-authored input-format examples, not AI output. The PowerPoint includes a visible revenue statement, speaker notes and a hidden slide. Legacy DOC/PPT versions were converted once with LibreOffice. The ZIP exercises import and path handling without invoking a model.
